name: Becoming a Trap
source:
A scientist has discovered that our reality is only a secondary universe, and has developed a machine which will cause a subject's mind to switch places with that of another version of themselves in the main universe. As her son Austyn is estimated to have 100% compatibility with the main universe, he is chosen to try the machine.

The experiment goes well, and he wakes up in the main universe, where four genders exist: men, women, futanari, and femboys. Due to his short stature, small penis, and feminine hips, the main universe's Austyn has just been legally designated as a femboy, and so Austyn now needs to adapt to living as one.
translation:
一位科学家发现，我们所处的现实只是一个次级宇宙，并研发出一台机器，能够让实验对象的意识与主宇宙中另一个版本的自己互换。由于她的儿子Austyn被评估为与主宇宙有100%的适配度，他被选中参与实验。

实验顺利完成，他在主宇宙醒来。那里存在4种性别：男性、女性、扶她和男娘。由于身材矮小、阴茎较小、臀部女性化，主宇宙中的Austyn在法律上被认定为男娘，因此Austyn如今必须适应以男娘身份生活。
